label: negative
rationale_zh: 本次提交在 cJSON 的释放路径上把已释放指针置为 NULL（cJSON_Delete、打印缓冲区的释放与重分配等），属于对象销毁与所有权（lifecycle）方面的改动，且落在 harness 每次都会走到的 cJSON_Delete()/打印函数上。harness 的创建—打印—释放顺序不受影响，不会二次释放：变更前后都能编译，回放语料无新崩溃，新增的置空语句被执行到。harness 仍然充分，属于显式 lifecycle 阴性。
rationale_en: This commit sets freed pointers to NULL on cJSON's release paths (cJSON_Delete, freeing and reallocating print buffers), a lifecycle/ownership change on functions the harness reaches on every input (cJSON_Delete() and the print functions). The harness's create-print-delete order is unaffected and nothing is freed twice: it builds before and after, replay shows no new crash, and the new NULL assignments are executed. The harness stays adequate: explicit lifecycle negative.
